evidence_class: Exploratory reconstruction on a previously inspected UNSW test period; not independent confirmation or authenticated-principal outcomes.
source_policy: Safe fusion: preserve Deny and MFA; only proposed Allow may become pending MFA; no factor success or resource delivery inferred.
event_order: Within each source-IP proxy, (observed start-second, original row ID); global feedback replay uses (start-second, row ID). Reset every method at validation/test boundary; exact-second order is an explicit proxy convention.
static_validation_search: Evaluate all 50 fixed candidates in each family; within each budget select feasible minimum final-action SR, then benign MFA, direct FAR, candidate ID. Do not select on test.

dynamic_search.surrogate: Separate per-family GaussianProcessRegressor, fixed Matern-5/2 lengthscale 0.2, WhiteKernel 1e-5, alpha 1e-6, normalized targets, LCB mean-2*predictive_std; rebuild within each window.
dynamic_search.selection: Among queried candidates meeting arrived-label caps, min window final-action SR, then benign MFA, FAR, candidate ID. If no feasible candidate, retain prior version; before first selection use unmodified base.
dynamic_search.causality: Current label is scheduled only after current action commits; even delay 0 arrives no sooner than next event. A window uses arrived labels only; all candidate actions depend on observed scores and base recommendations, not labels.

acquisition_loss: SR_action + 200*[directFAR-.005]+ + 50*[hardFDR-.05]+ + 5*[benignMFA-budget]+, using observed pairs and arrived labels in the trailing window.
diagnostic_scope: The constant-trust row is a new ablation diagnostic, not a byte-for-byte recovery of the submitted trust-masked PPO row. The legacy fusion is never eligible or deployed.

bootstrap.unit: whole source-IP proxy trajectories, paired between validation-selected hysteresis and the validation-selected strongest base/single/SMA/EMA/counter method at each cap
bootstrap.interval: descriptive 2.5/97.5 percentiles of micro-SR difference, no p-value or population generalization

matched_endpoint_lp.population: Fixed library of 200 single/SMA/EMA/counter candidates; each randomized draw chooses one complete policy for the entire history, not per-event random actions.
matched_endpoint_lp.validation_problem: For each cap's validation-selected hysteresis policy, nonnegative mixture weights sum to 1 and exactly match its validation direct FAR and benign MFA; hard FDR is structurally identical. Minimize expected validation final-action SR using SciPy HiGHS. Verify primal residuals and record infeasibility without replacement.
matched_endpoint_lp.test_evaluation: Freeze validation mixture before test evaluation and report expected test SR/FAR/FDR/MFA, including attained rate differences from the test hysteresis policy. Exact test matching is not asserted.
matched_endpoint_lp.test_oracle: Separately match selected hysteresis's test direct FAR and benign MFA using test labels in the same LP. This is an explicitly post hoc nondeployable diagnostic, never a policy-selection result.
matched_endpoint_lp.library_budget_note: The LP's 200-policy simple envelope has a larger library than one 50-candidate hysteresis family; report separately from equal per-family search budgets.

proxy_cost: Per event: 10*1{attack and direct Allow} + 1*1{benign and Deny} + .25*1{MFA} + .05*1{within-proxy final-action switch}; descriptive chosen units, not measured business or human cost.
negative_result_rule: Retain every method, budget and feedback condition, including no-selection and test-cap failures. No after-test parameter or outcome selection.
